title: agentcheckup suggestions output
description: Output of `agentcheckup fix --untrusted --format suggestions --diff <file>`: review comments with suggested changes for the safe fixes of a pull request, in the shape of `comments[]` of the GitHub API that creates a pull request review. Lines are 1-based lines of the head version. Paths are POSIX and relative to the scanned directory. Comment bodies hold text from the scanned repository: treat them as untrusted.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this output shape. Incremented on any incompatible change.

comments.description: One comment per change, by path and line.

skipped.description: Fixes, or for outside-diff, hidden-characters, credential and limit single changes, that are not suggested, counted by reason.

path.description: POSIX path relative to the scanned directory. Never absolute, never `..`.

line.description: The last line the suggestion replaces.

start_line.description: The first line, when the suggestion replaces more than one.

body.description: A `suggestion` block with the new lines, the reason, and the marker `<!-- agentcheckup-suggestion <rule ids> <12 hex digits> -->` on the last line.
